author: Rabia Asif
text:
The most exciting part of my job right now?

Watching our teams take ownership.

Every week, I see people stepping beyond their job descriptions, building new verticals, solving problems independently, and creating opportunities that didn't exist before. The only downside? They're making life incredibly difficult for our HR team because we keep needing more people.

We're currently hiring:

🎨 Creative Executives (Graphic Designers) who understand that design isn't decoration; it's storytelling. Every visual shapes the narrative.
🎬 News Video Editors who genuinely follow global affairs and can package stories across geopolitics, business, technology, finance, entertainment, and culture.
🤖 AI Video Editors who are excited by creative workflows powered by AI and want to redefine how stories are produced.
📺 Content Executives (probably the most fun role!) if you love binge-watching dramas and can't stop predicting what will happen next, this one's for you. You'll review content before release, identify what audiences will love, forecast viewership, uncover trends through data, and help shape release strategies. Think of it as being part critic, part strategist, part data detective.
📊 Data Scientists who believe content is a data business as much as it is a creative one, working on analytics, dashboards, audience intelligence, partner insights, and decision-making.
⚙️ ML & AI Engineers who want to automate processes across a modern media company, building tools that empower creators instead of replacing them.

But here's the important part.

My LinkedIn feed has been full of graduation photos over the past few weeks. Most of these roles require very little experience. We're not looking for people who've done everything before. We're looking for people who are excited to learn, ask questions, experiment, and grow. We'll build together.

Please apply only if media excites you.

This industry is demanding. It moves every hour. You have to care about stories, creators, news, sports, entertainment, culture, and technology. The people who thrive here aren't just technically brilliant, they're endlessly curious.

We're looking for intent. Curiosity. Ownership. And people who want to stand out by building things that matter.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you at careers@dotrepublicmedia.com.

The next generation of aerospace and defense technology will be built by the next generation of talent. ARC Aerospace is hiring Intern Technologists in software and electronics to support our Artificial Intelligence work — including navigation in GPS-denied environments, automatic target tracking and acquisition, and radar and communication systems. 

Job Title: Intern Technologist — Software & Electronics, AI Systems (Multiple Openings)
Location: El Paso, Texas
Duration: Paid Internship (Part-Time )
Compensation: Commensurate with qualifications and experience
Benefits: Hands-on training, mentorship from ARC engineers, and a pathway toward full-time technologist and engineering roles.

Position Overview
We are seeking motivated software and electronics Intern Technologists to support our AI systems team. Software interns will assist with data pipelines, machine learning model development and testing, simulation, and embedded software. Electronics interns will support sensor integration, radar and communication system bench testing, embedded hardware, and test infrastructure. Interns work side-by-side with ARC engineers and contribute directly to systems in active development.

Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
• Programming fundamentals in Python and/or C/C++ (software track)
• Fundamentals of circuits, microcontrollers, or signal processing (electronics track)
• Coursework or projects in AI/machine learning, computer vision, robotics, or embedded systems
• Strong work ethic, curiosity, and eagerness to learn
• Ability to document work clearly and collaborate in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, or ROS
• Exposure to RF fundamentals, software-defined radio, FPGAs, or radar/communications coursework
• Hands-on projects: robotics or drone clubs, senior design, hackathons, or personal builds
• Familiarity with Git, Linux, and test equipment (multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers)

Key Responsibilities
• Support development and testing of AI/ML models for navigation in GPS-denied environments and automatic target tracking and acquisition
• Assist with data collection, dataset preparation, and simulation environments
• Support integration and bench testing of radar and communication systems
• Build and maintain test setups, wiring, and sensor configurations
• Write, test, and document software components under engineer guidance
• Participate in design reviews, field tests, and technical documentation
